"Girl U Want" is a 1980 single by American new wave band Devo.
It was the first single released from their third studio album, Freedom of Choice (1980).

Composition
"Girl U Want" was allegedly inspired by the song "My Sharona" by the Knack, although Devo bassist and co-writer Gerald Casale has denied this claim.
Freedom of Choice (stylized as F R E E D O M O F C H O I C E) is the third studio album by the American new wave band Devo, released in May 1980 on Warner Bros.
The album contained their biggest hit, "Whip It", which hit No.
